description: The transcripts of LibriSpeech ASR corpus. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are LibriSpeech's `.trans.txt` files, inside archives that total about 61 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
